verdict.rationale: The probe found no llms.txt (HTTP 404 at developer.xero.com/llms.txt), and nothing in the evidence shows agent-oriented documentation (LLM-readable doc bundles or markdown docs for agent consumption). The AI Toolkit, MCP server and OpenAPI specs are building blocks for constructing agents or integrations. They are not docs an agent can be pointed at, so they earn no credit for this story.
